text: Hello, mujhe ek complaint raise karni thi. Maine ek crockery set order kiya tha worth Rs 2,199, par jab delivery boy ne box diya toh woh visibly crushed tha. Box ke andar se tutey hue glass ki aawaz bhi aa rahi thi, aur maine opening se pehle photos bhi click kar liye hain. Please check karke bataiye ki iska kya status hai aur mujhe replacement ya refund chahiye.
